steps.title: After the Tyrant appears
steps.rule: Go to 7m north-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 2m north-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 2m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Go to 7m north-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 7m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After Fearsome Fireball resolves
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ShadeSides has (1,2)).

steps.title: After Cosmic Kiss resolves
steps.rule: Go to 10m north-east of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Go to 7m north-west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 14m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After a tether lands on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ShadeSides has (1,2)).

steps.title: After Foregone Fatality hits you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ShadeSides has (1,2)).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ShadeSides has (0,2)).

steps.title: After Fearsome Fireball hits you
steps.rule: Go to 10m north-west of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to 2m west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 2m south of the centre.

steps.title: After Cosmic Kiss resolves
steps.rule: Go to 10m north-west of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 4, the south-west wall.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 7m north-east of the centre.

steps.title: After Foregone Fatality hits you
steps.rule: When ShadeSides leaves out (3,1), go to the north wall; when ShadeSides includes (3,1), go to the east wall.

OffTank.rule: When ShadeSides includes (1,2) and ShadeSides includes (3,0), go to the west wall; when ShadeSides includes (1,2) and ShadeSides leaves out (3,0), go to the south wall; when ShadeSides leaves out (1,2) and ShadeSides includes (3,0), go to the west wall; when ShadeSides leaves out (1,2) and ShadeSides leaves out (3,0), go to the west wall.

steps.title: After Fearsome Fireball hits you
steps.rule: Go to 10m north-east of the centre.
